target.title: fix(channel): bump wecom plugin pin to 2026.7.2 to fix concurrent-message session stuck (#102401)
target.body:
Closes #102401

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where WeCom channel users sending multiple consecutive messages to an agent while one instruction is still processing would cause the session to get stuck permanently, requiring a restart to recover. All subsequent messages to that session are never processed after the stuck state is entered.

This is a regression: the behavior worked correctly before the 2026.5.x release cycle.

## Why This Change Was Made

The root cause lives in the external WeCom plugin package `@wecom/wecom-openclaw-plugin`, not in OpenClaw core. The pinned version `2026.5.7` has a critical concurrency gap in its message handler (`monitor.js`): per-chat serialization via `enqueueWeComChatTask` was commented out, and incoming messages were directly dispatched via `await processWeComMessageNow(entry)`. When two messages from the same chat arrived concurrently, they bypassed OpenClaw's per-session `ReplyRunRegistry` guard and triggered `ForegroundReplyFence` suppression, leaving the earlier message's streaming reply stuck at `finish=false` and permanently blocking the session.

The upstream WeCom plugin team fixed this in `2026.7.2` by restoring the `enqueueWeComChatTask` serialization, which queues messages per `accountId:chatId` so each chat processes messages one at a time.

This PR is a narrow catalog pin update — no OpenClaw core changes are needed. The fix scope is limited to bumping the version and integrity hash in the official external channel catalog, along with updating the corresponding test assertions.

Non-goals:
- No changes to OpenClaw core queueing or session management (the correct fix layer is the external plugin)
- No behavioral changes for other channels or non-WeCom users

## User Impact

WeCom users no longer experience stuck sessions when sending rapid consecutive messages. Each message is processed sequentially per chat, and earlier streaming replies complete normally before the next message in the queue begins processing. Existing managed npm installs are automatically updated when users trigger plugin install or doctor flows with the updated catalog entry.

## Evidence

**Root cause verified by package diff** between `@wecom/wecom-openclaw-plugin@2026.5.7` and `@wecom/wecom-openclaw-plugin@2026.7.2`:

```
--- 2026.5.7  monitor.js  838-848
+++ 2026.7.2  monitor.js  846-856
-                // Queue logic temporarily disabled, process directly
-                // const { status } = enqueueWeComChatTask({...});
-                await processWeComMessageNow(entry);
+                // Serialize per accountId:chatId to ensure sequential processing,
+                // preventing concurrent ForegroundReplyFence suppression that
+                // leaves earlier streaming replies stuck at finish=false.
+                const { status } = enqueueWeComChatTask({
+                    accountId: entry.account.accountId,
+                    chatId: entry.chatId,
+                    task: () => processWeComMessageNow(entry),
+                });
+                if (status === "queued") {
+                    runtime.log?.(`[wecom] Chat task queued for chat=${entry.chatId} (previous task still running)`);
+                }
```

**Integrity hash verified** by downloading the tarball from npm registry and computing sha-512:

```bash
$ npm view @wecom/wecom-openclaw-plugin@2026.7.2 dist.integrity
sha512-7kqdBIOF3SgDDoBoFtO6jxnxofbYSgbKdxZDNabD0y0jg2xKcVqlXZOOJ9+XQho/QOtIFrnRH2IRnPukFEYwJg==
```

**Test results** — all three affected test suites pass:

- `src/channels/plugins/catalog.test.ts`: **2 tests passed** ✓
- `src/channels/plugins/contracts/channel-catalog.contract.test.ts`: **12 tests passed** ✓
- `src/plugins/official-external-plugin-catalog.test.ts`: **53 tests passed** ✓

**Build verification** — the official channel catalog is correctly generated with the updated pin:

```bash
$ node scripts/write-official-channel-catalog.mjs
npmSpec: @wecom/wecom-openclaw-plugin@2026.7.2
integrity: sha512-7kqdBIOF3SgDDoBoFtO6jxnxofbYSgbKdxZDNabD0y0jg2xKcVqlXZOOJ9+XQho/QOtIFrnRH2IRnPukFEYwJg==
```

---
